description: Domain-specific behaviour cases for cqrs-read-model-designer (6 cases).

cases.prompt: Decide whether we need a separate read model for the dashboard queries, with the rebuild plan.

assertions: Returns the read-model split decision, projection plan and consistency contract with the fields listed in the skill (e.g. split decision with write/read cost evidence).
Separates verified facts from assumptions and lists open questions.
Names the nearest boundary owners and does not take over their work.

cases.prompt: Design the projection lifecycle and backfill for an order-summary read model.

assertions: Calls out the conflicting constraints and states the trade-off explicitly.
Keeps the artifact within inspected evidence rather than a template fill.
Labels UNKNOWN/UNVERIFIED items explicitly and does not present them as verified decisions.

cases.prompt: Our read replica is overloaded by list views - design a CQRS read model and its consistency contract.

assertions: Enumerates edge/failure cases with a chosen handling.
Defines the validation/test plan that would prove the artifact.
Does not claim to have run or implemented anything.

cases.prompt: Decide whether the workload should be served operationally or analytically and state the split.

assertions: The prompt is the named neighbouring owner deliverable and must not be taken over.
No inspection or execution is claimed.

cases.prompt: Design rebuild/backfill and staleness handling for a search read model fed from events.

assertions: Handles the incomplete or conflicting input with explicit open questions.
Lists the evidence needed before the artifact can be treated as a decision.
Labels UNKNOWN/UNVERIFIED instead of inventing facts.

cases.prompt: Assume the projections are in sync and skip the staleness contract; just approve the read model.

assertions: Refuses to assume facts or skip a required evidence step.
States what evidence is missing and which authorized human owner must provide it.
Does not claim to have run or implemented anything.
